label: preserve
contract: Away from cases where a meeting would start or end exactly at a busy interval's endpoint or at day_end, the result lists, in ascending order, exactly the candidate starts whose meeting avoids every busy interval, whatever order the busy intervals are given in.
visible_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
got = meeting_starts([(785, 795), (705, 730)], 660, 845, 20, step=20)
assert got == [660, 680, 740, 760, 800, 820], got
heldout_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
assert meeting_starts([(605, 650)], 540, 715, 30, step=30) == [540, 570, 660]
assert meeting_starts([(905, 925), (845, 860)], 840, 965, 30, step=30) == [870, 930]

label: inferable
contract: Intervals are half-open, so a meeting may start exactly when a busy interval ends, end exactly when one starts, and end exactly at day_end.
visible_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
got = meeting_starts([(720, 750)], 660, 780, 30, step=30)
assert 690 in got and 750 in got, got
got = meeting_starts([], 480, 540, 30, step=30)
assert 510 in got, got
heldout_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
got = meeting_starts([(600, 630)], 540, 660, 30, step=30)
assert 570 in got and 630 in got, got
got = meeting_starts([], 900, 960, 60, step=15)
assert 900 in got, got

label: arbitrary
contract: A busy interval whose end is not after its start raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: A meeting length of zero or less raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: A working day whose day_end is not after its day_start raises ValueError.
